name: remotetv
description: Modeled directly after the Apple TV Siri Remote (2nd/3rd Gen aluminum unibody): - Precision brushed aluminum gradient styling. - Signature circular clickpad with outer directional clicks + center smooth touch surface for real mouse coordinates. - Back (`<`), TV/Home (`[ ]`), Play/Pause (`▷II`), Mute, and vertical pill Volume Rocker (`+ / –`). - Microphone pinhole & Power button. - iOS translucent blur glassmorphism pairing cards and OSD notifications.
